## Goal

The milestone's deploy chain has RUN GREEN on merged bytes - run 39197889153
completed success at 2026-10-19T04:07:25Z on `0c3dd6d`, and its job log carries
the mandated line `deploy verified: health endpoint is ok`. What does not exist
yet is the durable, machine-checkable RECORD of that fact: the criteria's final
step ("the deploy verification is evidenced") is unsatisfied until a card
commits an evidence artifact whose every value is MEASURED, not authored. This
card writes that artifact and the six fences that keep every number in it
honest. The card's discipline is what it must NOT do: it must not claim a
Render-side log this environment cannot capture, it must not edit a gate, and it
must not touch product files.

## Verification commands

ac_hash: sha256:2b529a1a 03893281 a0dfa555 142c6630 da3e05bb 5575318c e755186d 6fda9b25

Six fenced commands, byte-identical to
`evidence.verification_commands.ac1..ac6` in
`docs/state/outputs/t92_definer_groom.json`. The digest is sha256 over the
`JSON.stringify` array of the six FENCED BLOCKS in ac1..ac6 order, each block
taken exactly as it sits between its ```bash fences (the `bash -c '...'` wrapper
INCLUDED) with COMPACT separators and each block CR-stripped and trimmed - the
t58/t62..t91 recipe, so the digest covers the command exactly as it is pasted
rather than a re-derived form. The full 64-hex value is written in the handoff
JSON and appears here only as eight spaced groups, because `docs/` IS
gitleaks-scanned and a bare 64-hex literal in a doc is both a scan surface and
a second source of truth for a value the fences measure. Recomputed from the
card on disk by the verifier's own replay, this digest must reproduce.

Command sizes (bytes): 52989, 52989, 52989, 52989, 52989, 52989. All six fences carry the SAME probe payload
(the python all six materialise into a private temp dir) and select a mode, so
the probe source digest is one value: `e800beac` (first 8 chars; full value
in the handoff). All six fail loudly if python3 or base64 is missing rather
than skipping. ac2 and ac4 reach the NETWORK (the GitHub actions API and the
live health endpoint) - a read that cannot be made is a RED, never a skip;
ac1, ac3, ac5 and ac6 are read-only against the repo plus git through the
cmd.exe bridge.

No gate amendment accompanies this card: the groom scan found no stored gate
that this card's record can flip (no gate mentions t92, the run id, the log
line or the banked artifact), so unlike t89/t90 there is nothing to hand the
orchestrator for the merge window.

## Constraints (hard)

- ZERO gate edits. `docs/state/merge_test_index.json` is orchestrator-owned;
  this card has NO amendment (ac6's blob/identity legs fence it). A card that
  edits a gate to accommodate its evidence is a FAIL by definition.
- ZERO product edits. The builder commits ONLY
  `docs/state/outputs/t92_deploy_evidence.json` plus its own card/mirror/handoff
  room. `render.yaml`, `.github/**`, `backend/**`, `frontend/**`, `README.md`,
  `docs/criteria/**` are other cards' property (ac6's bookkeeping + delta legs).
- Every value in the record is MEASURED at build time from the platform API,
  the committed banked log, or the live health endpoint - never typed from this
  card's prose. The fences re-measure independently; a record copied from the
  card but not from the platform goes RED on ac2/ac3/ac4.
- The Render-log gap stays a DISCLOSED limitation: `render_log_gap.captured`
  stays false, the reason stays the measured one (no Render API token in .env),
  and no field may contain a captured Render build/migration log body or claim
  (ac5's forbidden-claim legs). Fabricating such a log is the single worst
  failure this card could commit.
- The record may cite ONLY re-readable sources: GitHub actions endpoints for
  `HsiChinHuang/expense-tracker-dashboard`, the committed banked-log path, and
  the live health URL. Render dashboard URLs are not re-readable from this
  environment and may not be cited as sources (ac5).
- No secret may appear anywhere in the record or in probe output: the banked
  log's `***` masking, the absence of the hook URL and of the `.env` token are
  fenced by ac3.
- Health payload is captured as the endpoint answers it NOW (measured at groom:
  the four-key object with version 1.0.0); if it moves before build, the record
  must re-capture and ac4 re-premises - the record never edits yesterday's
  capture to match today's endpoint.

## Out of scope

- Any change to `docs/state/merge_test_index.json` (orchestrator-owned; the
  t90 amendment is applied and merely cited here), the register-count gates
  (t93), the README pins (t94/t96), `/health` version single-sourcing (t97),
  issue #61 closure (t95), and the script-side URL/register migrations
  (t93/t98) - none of those files are this card's, and ac6's delta legs say so.
- Render dashboard-side actions (service logs, deploy history, blueprint sync
  in the UI): no Render token exists here; the card's contract is the committed
  record plus the GitHub-side evidence it binds.
- Re-running or re-triggering any deploy: this card RECORDS the run that
  already happened on merged bytes; firing the deploy hook again would replace
  the very evidence it exists to pin.
- Extending the record to future runs: it is ONE run at ONE wall-clock time by
  construction, and `disclosed_limits` says so. A phase_15 continuous-evidence
  mechanism is not this card's decision.
